Which literature refers to Andhras as ‘Andhakaratta’
x:
The term "Andhakaratta" appears in Jain literature as a reference to the Andhra region. Ancient Jain texts used the word Andhakaratta (Andhra-rashtra) to denote the country inhabited by the Andhras. Such references demonstrate that Andhra had emerged as a recognized geographical and cultural region even in the early historic period. These literary references, together with Buddhist texts and inscriptions, provide valuable evidence for reconstructing the early history of Andhra.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (3).

s: Which of the following ancient texts does not mention the Telugu people?
x:
The Rigveda does not contain any reference to the Telugu (Andhra) people. Ancient references to the Andhras are found in: • Aitareya Brahmana – Earliest Vedic reference to the Andhras. • Arthasastra of Kautilya – Mentions the Andhras as an important political entity. • Rajatarangini – Contains references to the Andhra region in later historical contexts.
Therefore, among the given options, Rigveda is the only text that does not mention the Telugu people.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (1).
